name: Prepare a vendor security questionnaire response
why: Maps each questionnaire item to evidence and lists open questions, the same method as the security-questionnaire-and-rfp-answers skill.

name: Prepare evidence for a compliance review
why: Builds an evidence index and gap list, useful before a buyer's security review or when the answer bank needs current proof.

name: Track promises made to pilot customers
why: Keeps a register of what each pilot customer was promised, with owners and proof, to back the pilot plan and hand-off.

name: Prepare an AI pilot go decision
why: Checks pilot results against a baseline and a go or stop checklist, a close match for the pilot readout.

name: Objection answer sheet writer
why: Turns the doubts buyers raise into an answer sheet; pair it with the honest technical answers in the objection skill.

name: Hardest objections answer writer
why: Finds the toughest objections to a pitch before the buyer's technical lead does.

name: Sales call question planner
why: Plans discovery questions that fill the gaps the discovery-gap-check prompt finds.

name: Sales call prep assistant
why: A one-page plan from the last call's notes, handy before a technical session or pilot check-in.

name: Honest persuasion editor
why: Checks sales copy for made-up proof and fake urgency, the same claims discipline this kit asks for.

name: Quarterly battle card keeper
why: Refreshes battle cards from won and lost deals so technical comparisons with rivals stay true.

name: Monthly lost deal reviewer
why: Finds why deals were really lost, including technical reasons, to improve demos and objection answers.
